args.title: Make error toasts persistent and announced assertively
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error-kind toasts should render in a region with role="alert"/aria-live="assertive" (or a separate live region) instead of sharing the polite status region, and the Toast component should skip the AUTO_DISMISS_MS timeout for kind === "error" so they remain visible until the user dismisses them.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The toast stack uses a single role="status" aria-live="polite" region for all toast kinds, and the Toast component always sets a timeout to auto-dismiss after AUTO_DISMISS_MS regardless of kind, which matches the reported behavior of error toasts being announced politely and disappearing after five seconds.
